Goetz Eq. (6) conduction-band DOS input (m_de = 0.19 m0 with M_C = 6 or 12, not committed) disagrees with Persson & Lindefelt (nu = 3, m_c = 0.37 m0) by up to 2x; the DOS-specific source (Persson) is used.

E_g(300 K) = E_GX(300 K) + E_ex = 3.2326 + 0.030 = 3.263 eV (range 3.253-3.273 eV from E_ex uncertainty); independently recomputed by the verifier. Consistent with the Galeckas 2002 value 3.2625 eV quoted (secondary) by the Burin review.
Grivickas et al. quote N_C = 1.66e19 (T/300)^1.5 cm^-3 citing Persson & Lindefelt (MSF 1998) - not a measurement; used only as a reported cross-check (R7a).
